pet_notes: Use Hu Tao references as identity and costume authorities. Favor the compact full-body proportions of the chibi references while retaining all recognizable costume landmarks from the front model reference. The hat and blossom branch are inseparable silhouette landmarks. Keep the same eye design, face, hair shape, body proportions, garment patterning, and accessory handedness across every frame. Expressions may be playful but must remain readable at 192x208 pet size. Use body acting only; no ghost, weapon, text, motion lines, speed marks, dust, glow, or detached effects. Keep full body visible and feet grounded except in jumping.
style_notes: Polished clean 2D chibi anime sprite art with crisp dark outlines, compact readable silhouette, soft cel shading, large expressive crimson flower-pupil eyes, warm pale skin, long dark brown hair fading to muted red tips, and accurate deep brown-black-red-gold costume. Preserve the tall dark hat with beige talisman plaque and red plum-blossom branch on the wearer’s screen-right side, dark side tassel, long coat tails, white socks with red ribbon accents, and dark shoes. No ghost companion, no weapon, no text, no badge outline, no shadows, no detached effects.
